from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and applicable case type(s)."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_types: List[Literal['管辖案件', '民事案件', '执行案件', '刑事案件', '行政案件']] = Field(description="The list of case type categories this document belongs to, derived from the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[CaseDocument]
